name: House Of The Sun
source:
You're not a college freshman. You're not a war veteran. You're not a private detective. You're just a guy who, at a young age, decided he wanted to be a ladies' man.
But, what do you do when you've already achieved your goal, and every week you have a new girl in bed to forget the total emptiness inside for a few hours?

It's been six years: you're lonely, disappointed in life, in women, in yourself, with no relationship-building skills. But you want to change that, work with a therapist, and decide to go far away from the bustling city and get your head straight.

A month or two in a remote village with friendly people, what can go wrong?
But will you be able to change your attitude towards women, find intimacy, or will you be stuck in your cold world?

The choice is yours. Learn to care or be consumed by hatred.

[From [url=https://ern-the-skald.itch.io/house-of-the-sun]Itch.io[/url]]
